protocol.v: 五个数据集（Chest, Jaw, Foot, Abdomen, Aorta）；人体器官数据用 TIGRE 生成 50 个投影、180° 范围、3% 噪声；Aorta 用 GE C-arm 采集，仅使用 50 个投影；评价指标为 PSNR 和 SSIM。
protocol.excerpt:
We conduct experiments on five datasets containing human organ and phantom data. Details are listed in Table 1.
Human organ: We evaluate our method using public datasets of human organ CTs [4,12], including chest, jaw, foot and abdomen. The chest data are from LIDC-IDRI dataset [4], and the rest are from Open Scientific Visualization Datasets [12]. Since these datasets only provide volumetric CT scans, we generate projections by a tomographic toolbox TIGRE [5]. In TIGRE [5], we capture 50 projections with 3% noise in the range of 180◦. We train our model with these projections and evaluate its performance with the raw volumetric CT data.
Phantom: We collect a phantom dataset by scanning a silicon aortic phantom with GE C-arm Medical System. This system captures 582 500×500 fluoroscopy projections with position primary angle from -103◦to 93◦and position secondary angle of 0◦. A 512×512×510 CT image is also generated with inbuilt algorithms as the ground truth. We only use 50 projections for experiments.

evidence.v: FDK [7] 在 Chest/Jaw/Foot/Abdomen/Aorta 上的 PSNR/SSIM 分别为 22.89/.78、28.59/.78、23.92/.58、22.39/.59、12.11/.21。
SART [2] 在 Chest/Jaw/Foot/Abdomen/Aorta 上的 PSNR/SSIM 分别为 32.12/.95、32.67/.93、30.13/.93、31.38/.92、27.31/.77。
ASD-POCS [20] 在 Chest/Jaw/Foot/Abdomen/Aorta 上的 PSNR/SSIM 分别为 29.78/.92、32.78/.93、28.67/.89、30.34/.91、27.30/.76。
IntraTomo3D [28] 在 Chest/Jaw/Foot/Abdomen/Aorta 上的 PSNR/SSIM 分别为 31.94/.95、31.95/.91、31.43/.91、30.43/.90、29.38/.82。
NAF (Ours) 在 Chest/Jaw/Foot/Abdomen/Aorta 上的 PSNR/SSIM 分别为 33.05/.96、34.14/.94、31.63/.94、34.45/.95、30.34/.88。
作者报告 NAF 在人体器官与体模数据集上均取得定量最佳结果，PSNR 与 SSIM 均显著高于其他方法。
evidence.excerpt: Our method produces quantitatively best results in both human organ and phantom datasets as listed in Table 2. Both PSNR and SSIM values are significantly higher than other methods.

stability.interpretation: AI解读：在 Table 2 所列五个数据集上，NAF 的 PSNR/SSIM 数值均高于同表其他四种方法，呈现跨数据集一致的数值优势；此为单次实验报告的数值一致性，不等同于跨随机种子统计稳定性。

evidence.v: 作者报告 NAF 在重建 CT 体积的所有切片上均优于其他方法。
evidence.excerpt: Fig. 3 indicates that NAF outperforms other methods in all slices of the reconstructed CT volume.

stability.interpretation: AI解读：作者以 Fig. 3 声称逐切片优势，但该图内具体数值未在文本中给出，需核对原 PDF 图 3。

evidence.v: 作者报告在 abdomen 数据集上，迭代方法与学习方法在不同输入视图数量下性能随视图增加而上升，NAF 在多数情况下优于其他方法。
evidence.excerpt: Figure 4 shows the performance of iterative methods and learning-based methods under different number of views. It is clear that the performance increases with the rise of input views. Our methods achieves better results than others under most circumstances.

generalization.interpretation: AI解读：该结论限于 abdomen 数据集与作者测试的视图数量范围；具体视图数量与数值需核对 Fig. 4。逐病例自监督优化不等同于固定模型跨域迁移，跨域泛化协议论文中未说明。

evidence.v: 作者称 NAF 为自监督方法，除感兴趣对象的 X 射线投影外不需要外部 CT 扫描。
evidence.excerpt: Here we use ‘self-supervised’ to highlight that NAF requires no external CT scans but the X-ray projections of the interested object.

generalization.interpretation: AI解读：该表述说明方法不依赖外部训练数据，但每个病例需单独优化；论文未报告固定模型跨数据集迁移实验，跨域泛化能力待核对。

evidence.v: 作者报告 NAF 可在 10-40 分钟内重建详细 CT 模型，与迭代方法相当。
evidence.excerpt: method can reconstruct a detailed CT model within 10-40 minutes, which is comparable to iterative methods.

efficiency.interpretation: AI解读：原文以“reconstruct a detailed CT model within 10-40 minutes”描述重建耗时，未区分训练与推理阶段；具体数据集对应耗时需核对 Fig. 5。

evidence.v: 作者报告 NAF 运行时间与迭代方法相近，且比频率编码深度学习方法 IntraTomo3D 快 3 倍。
evidence.excerpt: Benefiting from the compact network design, NAF spends similar running time to iterative methods and is 3×faster than the frequency-encoding deep learning method IntraTomo3D.

efficiency.interpretation: AI解读：该 3× 为作者报告值，具体各方法耗时数值需核对 Fig. 5；原文称 IntraTomo3D 训练网络需超过一小时。
